reason: The plugin expands DeepSeek Harness file-write access from the session workspace to every registered workspace by modifying sandbox policy checks and write operations; human review is warranted because this broadens filesystem permissions.

summaries.zh: 该插件将 DeepSeek Harness 的文件写入范围扩展到所有已注册工作区，无需额外配置即可写入这些工作区。
summaries.en: This plugin extends DeepSeek Harness file-write access to all registered workspaces without requiring additional configuration.

capabilities: expands writable filesystem roots to all registered workspaces
retries file writes across workspace roots
